title: Stage contract (pipeline/<stage>/io.yaml)
description: The machine-readable half of an LLM stage (ADR-0002). INSTRUCTIONS.md next to it is the prompt. Placeholders in paths ({user}, {job_id}, {master}) are filled from params; every engine (a Claude Code skill, `cvac stage pack` for any chat, an API runner) reads the same contract.

stage.description: Directory name; the number orders the pipeline

gate.description: human: the output carries a status and only a person may set it to approved

output_language.description: pivot: the profile's pivot_language · target: the CV/letter language · posting: the language of the job posting · english: the framework's own

params.description: Placeholders the paths need; the engine must provide them

optional.description: true: may be absent (the pack says so instead of failing)

schema.description: Schema file in the package validating the output (the frontmatter, for markdown-frontmatter)
